channel.description: Latest articles from Hull What's On (hullwhatson.com)

item.title: Year 6 pupils’ community project funds St Mary’s School reading corner
item.description: Year 6 pupils at St Mary’s School in Beverley raised £525 to create a new reading corner as part of the National Year of Reading 2026.

item.title: Hull expands SEND Outreach Partnership
item.description: Hull has expanded its SEND outreach partnership, strengthening training and specialist support for schools and inclusive education across the city.

item.title: Terrific spots for Dry January in Hull & East Yorkshire
item.description: January is here, and for those taking part in Dry January, Hull and East Yorkshire have plenty of lovely spots where you can still enjoy a proper night out without the alcohol. More pubs and bars across the region are putting real thought into their low and non-alcoholic options, making it easier to head out […]

item.title: 8 must-try Vegan spots in Hull & East Yorkshire
item.description: Every day in Britain more and more people are turning to meat-free options, and luckily for those living here, Hull and East Yorkshire are home to a growing selection of vegan-friendly eateries, offering everything from indulgent desserts to hearty meals! For those of you that are interested in visiting the local area’s vegetarian and vegan […]

item.title: Hull accountants share tips for filing your self assessment this January
item.description: January is the busiest month of the year for Self Assessment, and for many people in Hull, it’s their first time tackling it. Whether you’ve recently gone self-employed, started freelancing, or picked up extra income, the process can feel confusing at first. With the 31 January deadline approaching, here are some practical tips to help […]

item.title: Scale Lane footbridge: next phase of investigations announced ahead of repair programme
item.description: Hull City Council has confirmed the next phase of investigations on Scale Lane footbridge as part of plans to repair its unique swing mechanism.

item.title: Lord Mayor’s Valentine’s event to showcase songs from the decades
item.description: A Valentine’s music night in Hull will raise funds for the Lord Mayor’s charities, with live songs from the 1950s through to the 2000s at the New Walton Club.

item.title: Emergency removal of carved Hull 2017 tree stump in Pearson Park
item.description: The carved Hull 2017 tree sculpture in Pearson Park has been safely removed after deterioration made it unstable, with the artwork remaining in the park to decay naturally as wildlife habitat.

item.title: Council response to Hull missing out on rail electrification
item.description: Hull City Council responds after Hull misses out on rail electrification, calling for clear commitments and fair funding in Northern Powerhouse Rail plans.

item.title: Hull exhibition designer celebrates 16 years after starting business post-redundancy
item.description: A Hull-based exhibition designer who set up her business the day after being made redundant during the financial crisis is celebrating 16 years of national and international success.
